title: list_inputs — user input list (turn anchors)
description: Domain: session/message. Sources: worker src/worker_rpc.rs:1713; host intercept src/bin/ion.rs:7912 (same data shape). Worker surface takes no params; host surface requires params.session. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.

turnId.description: Anchor entry id of the turn (NOT the numeric turn number; see fork for the numeric form).
